name: conservatory
description: a glass-walled room filled with the skeletons of dead plants in clay pots. the air is humid and thick, carrying the sweet-sickly smell of decaying vegetation. a wrought-iron table and chairs sit in the centre, rusted and listing. vines have crept through broken window panes, snaking across the floor like green tentacles. a door leads to the garden.

items.name: table_8625c82c
items.description: a wrought-iron table with a cracked glass top. a water-damaged notebook lies on it, pages bloated with moisture.

items.name: plant
items.description: a withered fern in a clay pot. it crumbles to dust when touched. beneath the dust, something glints in the soil.

items.name: garnet_ring
items.description: a delicate gold ring set with a small garnet. inside: 'forever, a.b.' — augustus blackwood's gift to someone who wasn't his wife.

items.name: watering_can
items.description: a rusty watering can. empty. when you pick it up, something rattles inside — a small object.

items.name: key_fragment
items.description: half of a broken brass key. the teeth are intricate and finely crafted. someone deliberately broke this key in half. the other half must be somewhere in the mansion.

items.name: rain_barrel
items.description: a barrel catching rainwater through a broken pane. the water is murky with leaf litter but could be filtered through cloth.

items.name: dead_vine
items.description: a thick, dead vine that has grown through a broken window. it's woody and brown, but when you touch it, it feels... warm. alive.

items.name: key_fragment_2
items.description: the other half of a broken brass key. the break is clean, matching the fragment you found in the watering can. together, they would form a complete key.

items.name: broken_key
items.description: a brass key that has been ritually broken in half and bound with an occult heat-seal. the two halves, when joined, form a complete key. the tag reads: 'eleanor's hope chest — never to be opened.'

exits.description: french doors leading to the conservatory, their glass panels fogged with condensation.
a glass-paneled door leading to the garden. the garden beyond looks overgrown but peaceful.
